title: Define Customer Commitment Scoring for Hosted API Enterprise Intake (chat/streaming/toolcalls/structured)
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Objective: Create a reproducible, explainable Customer Commitment Score (CCS) to triage incoming enterprise feature requests for the Hosted API surface (chat, streaming, function/tool calling, structured outputs). The score will combine commercial signals, technical risk, compliance urgency, and product fit to produce a single prioritized value used by the intake queue and escalation playbooks.

Why: Current intake decisions are inconsistent across SDR/Sales/CS handoffs and rely heavily on subjective judgment. A transparent CCS will help align Product, Sales Engineering, and Eng on which customer asks to accelerate (Dedicated/private conversions, SLA needs, or platform changes) while surfacing low-effort high-impact work for self-serve.

Scope: Enterprise-hosted-API non-bug feature asks only. Excludes billing, legal-only requests, and infra incidents. The score should support manual overrides and attach rationale (links to contract, P0 SLO target, integration notes).
acceptance_criteria: Define scoring signals and normalized scale (0-100) with weightings and justification
Implement intake form fields mapping to signals and automated score calculation in Curations table (mocked for rollout)
Create triage mapping: score buckets -> routing (self-serve backlog / PM review / SE + Eng pre-sales / Sales escalation to prioritization board)
Document decision rules and examples for 10 representative enterprise requests (chat streaming, long-running toolchains, structured output schema changes)
Pilot the score for 30 days with Sales Engineering on new inbound enterprise requests and collect qualitative feedback
Provide dashboard: counts by score bucket, average time-to-decision, and acceptance rate of routed items
notes_and_updates: 2025-02-12 - Aisha: Kickoff draft; initial scope agreed with Maria (Sales) and Jonah (Solutions Eng). Will re-use request fields from existing hosted-api intake form and add commercial/contract fields.

2025-02-15 - Marco: Drafted candidate signals list (Revenue ARR impact, Contractual SLA requirement, Churn risk, Technical complexity estimate, Integration effort, Regulatory deadline, Customer tenure, Existing workaround maturity). Shared with ENG and SE for feedback.
2025-02-18 - Beth (Eng): Suggested adding 'runtime dependency' signal and mapping to runtime-1.21 compatibility; flagged dependency on ENG-4221 for runtime rollout timelines.
2025-02-20 - Design review (Lena): Proposed intake form UI that surfaces calculated CCS with explanation tooltip and 'override' action requiring reason and approver.

2025-02-24 - Marco: Built a scoring prototype in Sheets with normalization rules and sample weights. Initial threshold candidates: Low 0-24, Medium 25-59, High 60-79, Critical 80-100. Shared with PM leads for comment.

2025-02-26 - Sales feedback (Maria): Ask to include 'Contractual commitment' binary field (signed PO or letter of intent) — will weight heavily; requested ability to fast-track for customers with Dedicated deals.

2025-02-28 - PM sync: Agreed pilot plan: 30-day pilot for incoming enterprise requests; collect both quantitative metrics and log qualitative disposition notes. Assigned Marco to implement mock auto-score in Curations table and Aisha to prepare decision rubric doc.
implementation_notes: Proposed signals (examples): ARR impact (normalized log scale), Contractual SLA required (binary + urgency), Commitment evidence (PO/LOI), Churn risk (CS input 1-5), Technical complexity (SE estimate 1-5), Runtime compatibility (runtime change required vs compatible), Security/compliance mandated (GDPR/CCPA/sector-specific), Implementation estimate (engineering points), Customer strategic importance (enterprise tier). We will normalize each to 0-1, apply weights, and scale to 0-100. Store raw signals on request record and render score breakdown in Console intake view.
decision_routing_matrix: Score 0-24 -> Self-serve backlog with PM lite review; 25-59 -> PM backlog with SE triage (30-day review); 60-79 -> Expedite: schedule Solutions Eng + Eng scoping meeting within 7 days; 80-100 -> Priority board + Sales escalation (include legal and CSM), consider Dedicated/private offering and SLA uplift.
risks_and_tradeoffs: Weighting sensitivity may bias toward revenue or low-effort items; require periodic calibration. Automated scoring risks missing contextual signals (captured via override with justification). Pilot must capture false-positives/negatives and we may need to introduce ML-based ranking later. Some signals require reliable inputs from Sales/CS; initial adoption risk if those teams don't consistently populate fields.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): finalize scoring rubric, add fields to intake form, prototype scoring in Sheets and Curations mock. Phase 2 (4 weeks): implement auto-score in intake tool, add UI explanation and override flow, train SE/Sales/CS. Phase 3 (30-day pilot): measure routing accuracy, time-to-decision, and stakeholder satisfaction. Phase 4: iterate weights and move to automated production calculation integrated with ticket routing and dashboarding (console-2025.03 release).
metrics: Primary: median time from request to routed outcome, percent of requests routed to correct bucket (manual audit), number of overrides and reasons. Secondary: conversion to Dedicated/reserved deals, reduction in Mean Time To Engage for high-score items.
